notes_ru: Normal combat expects a mid-rank fighting ship.
Normal ore expects a real crusher
Carry enough processed stone to matter.
Do not draw every patrol at once.
Normal gas expects working siphons and filters.
Normal hunt expects a real capture tool.
Normal repair expects actual repair beams.
Danger combat expects a strong late ship.
Danger hunt expects serious harpoons or cutters.
Danger salvage uses active automaton fields.
Elite combat is for top fighting ships.
Elite ore is about brutal crusher pressure
Small enemies chip away during extraction.
Elite gas needs powerful filters and resistant systems.
Elite hunt expects top capture systems.
Elite salvage expects serious dismantling tools.
Elite courier is high-value freight under route pressure.
Elite repair expects flagship repair output.
Do not become the main target.
